_comment: ALWAYS 0: Terra Continental's radial field decides all landmass placement. Every consumer blends as (island_selector * island_branch + continent_selector * continent_branch) with continent_selector = 1 - island_selector, so 0 routes all four consumers (noise/full_continents, biome_parameter/erosion, biome_parameter/ridges, terrain_spline/offset/final) to the continent branch, which is keyed on raw_continents (the radial field). The island branch would fire where raw_continents is in [-1, -0.5), which is the radial field's deep ocean, and scatter small islands there; its raw_islands = (max(island_a,island_b) + 0.05) * spline(rc) - 0.7 also drives continentalness as low as -1.365, through the -1.02 mushroom floor that continent_base keeps (vanilla's mushroom band is below -1.05), so it would scatter mushroom_fields too.
